import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 262144;
    static int L, n, k, Mo, len, bit[] = new int[20], fac[] = new int[MAX_SIZE], inv[] = new int[MAX_SIZE], cnt[] = new int[MAX_SIZE], g[][] = new int[20][MAX_SIZE], f[][] = new int[20][MAX_SIZE], h[] = new int[20], p[] = new int[20];

    static int power(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (int)((long)result * base % Mo);
            base = (int)((long)base * base % Mo);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void add_mod(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] = x[0] + y >= Mo ? x[0] + y - Mo : x[0] + y;
    }

    static void sub_mod(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] = x[0] - y < 0 ? x[0] - y + Mo : x[0] - y;
    }

    static void transform_FWT(int[] a, int len) {
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    add_mod(new int[]{a[j + k + i]}, a[j + k]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void transform_IFWT(int[] a, int len) {
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    sub_mod(new int[]{a[j + k + i]}, a[j + k]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void get_ln(int[] a, int[] b, int n) {
        b[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            b[i] = (int)((long)a[i] * i % Mo);
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                b[i] = (int)((b[i] + Mo - (long)b[j] * a[i - j] % Mo * j) % Mo);
            }
            b[i] = (int)((long)b[i] * power(i, Mo - 2) % Mo);
        }
    }

    static void get_exp(int[] a, int[] b, int n) {
        b[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            b[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                b[i] = (int)((b[i] + (long)a[j] * b[i - j] % Mo * j) % Mo);
            }
            b[i] = (int)((long)b[i] * power(i, Mo - 2) % Mo);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        L = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        Mo = sc.nextInt();

        int total = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < L; i++) {
            total = (int)((long)total * k % Mo);
        }
        if ((L & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(total);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % Mo);
        }
        inv[L] = power(fac[L], Mo - 2);
        for (int i = L - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % Mo);
        }

        for (int s = 1; s <= L; s++) {
            cnt[s] = cnt[s ^ (s & -s)] + 1;
        }

        n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (((L >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                bit[++n] = 1 << i;
            }
        }

        len = 1 << n;

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (((i >> (j - 1)) & 1) == 1) {
                    s += bit[j];
                }
            }
            g[cnt[i]][i] = inv[s];
        }

        transform_FWT(g[0], len);
        transform_FWT(g[1], len);
        transform_FWT(g[2], len);

        for (int s = 0; s < len; s++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = g[i][s];
            }
            get_ln(h, p, n);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                p[i] = (int)((long)p[i] * k % Mo);
            }
            get_exp(p, h, n);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                f[i][s] = h[i];
            }
        }

        transform_IFWT(f[n], len);
        int answer = (int)((long)f[n][len - 1] * fac[L] % Mo);
        answer = (total - answer + Mo) % Mo;
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
